provenance: Original synthetic small benchmark workload contract; functional timing exercise, not a production performance claim.
index_order: lexicographic i,j,k with k varying fastest
positions_nm: For i,j,k in range(6), base=(0.4+0.45*i,0.4+0.45*j,0.4+0.45*k). Add independent random.Random(17).uniform(-0.01,0.01) jitter to each component in index order, using one RNG instance.
